contract.note: A substantial retreat from earlier pretraining expectations is an ordinary contextual reading. Its breadth requires evidence beyond adoption of additional scaling methods.

contract.note: Testing changes in inference budget is the ordinary reading of test-time compute scaling. Cross-model differences alone cannot establish that effect, despite their use in the surrounding argument.
